fields.Participants: MSME Sales, Partner Bank, Treasury, Compliance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-track of "tracks partner-bank settlement and any revenue-share" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-477 (ensure controlled execution — MSME Growth, Credit & Digital Enablement (PA-82.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Regulatory risk**: Sharing MSME data without consent violates Data Privacy Act; mitigated by explicit consent capture
System Touchpoints: - Consent management; partner-bank API; loan-repayment tracking

steps.activity: MSME Sales refers qualified MSME to partner bank (or SBCorp/DTI microfinance program) for "Negosyo Loan"; provides purchase history as credit evidence
Partner bank underwrites using BuildRight transaction data (consented); disburses loan; funds may flow directly to BuildRight for inventory purchase
Compliance ensures data-sharing consent and BSP Open Finance compliance; Treasury tracks partner-bank settlement and any revenue-share

fields.Participants: Treasury, Finance, MSME Sales, Partner Financier
fields.Trigger: MSME or partner financier requests early payment

workflows.name: MSME Receivables Financing, Factor & Receivable Discounting

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "MSME requests early payment discount" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-assign of "assigns receivables with notice" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconciles factor advance and recourse" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-477 (ensure controlled execution — MSME Growth, Credit & Digital Enablement (PA-82.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Credit risk**: Recourse factoring exposes BuildRight to MSME default; mitigated by non-recourse structuring where viable
System Touchpoints: - Receivables financing module; partner financier API; GL settlement

steps.activity: MSME requests early payment discount (e.g., 2% for 10-day vs. 30-day); Treasury evaluates cost vs. cash benefit
Finance structures receivable discounting or factoring arrangement with partner financier; assigns receivables with notice
Treasury settles discounted payment; reconciles factor advance and recourse; reports program yield and MSME adoption

workflows.name: MSME Digital Store Upgrade & E-Load/E-Wallet Onboarding

Automation Opportunity: - System workflow orchestration of "coordinates bulk onboarding events at stores" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "tracks MSME digital adoption, e-wallet transaction volume, and incremental…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-477 (ensure controlled execution — MSME Growth, Credit & Digital Enablement (PA-82.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Adoption risk**: MSME hesitation to digital; mitigated by hands-on onboarding and incentives
System Touchpoints: - MSME digital-readiness scorecard; e-wallet partner portal; adoption analytics

steps.activity: MSME Sales assesses MSME digital readiness; recommends e-wallet (GCash/Maya) merchant onboarding, e-load resale, and bill-payment services
E-wallet partner onboards MSME merchant; BuildRight coordinates bulk onboarding events at stores; provides setup support
Marketing tracks MSME digital adoption, e-wallet transaction volume, and incremental BuildRight orders; reports program ROI

fields.Trigger: MSME opts into BuildRight-provided digital tools

workflows.name: MSME Point-of-Sale / Inventory App Provisioning & Support

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitors adoption and issues" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "IT maintains app, security patches, and integration with BuildRight" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-477 (ensure controlled execution — MSME Growth, Credit & Digital Enablement (PA-82.3).)
- operational: self-service content and tiered support
Pain Points / Risks: - **Support risk**: Volume of MSME support requests; mitigated by self-service content and tiered support
System Touchpoints: - MSME POS/inventory app; integration APIs; support ticketing

steps.activity: IT provisions MSME with BuildRight-provided POS/inventory app (or integration with sari-sari POS); configures reorder templates and supplier linkage
Customer Service trains MSME on app usage; provides hotline/chat support; monitors adoption and issues
IT maintains app, security patches, and integration with BuildRight catalog/order system; manages data privacy and consent

fields.Participants: MSME Sales, Marketing, Category Manager, Compliance

workflows.name: MSME Data Monetization & BuildRight Supplier Co-Marketing

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validates MSME consent for data use" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "tracks supplier-funded revenue and incremental MSME orders" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-477 (ensure controlled execution — MSME Growth, Credit & Digital Enablement (PA-82.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Privacy risk**: Using MSME data without consent; mitigated by granular consent and transparency
System Touchpoints: - Consent management; campaign management; supplier billing (RMN-style, VS-48 linkage)

steps.activity: Category Manager/Marketing identifies supplier interest in reaching MSME segment via BuildRight channel; structures co-marketing campaign
Compliance validates MSME consent for data use; executes campaign via app notifications, in-order inserts, or Negosyo Academy content
Finance tracks supplier-funded revenue and incremental MSME orders; reports program economics and supplier satisfaction

workflows.name: MSME Loyalty, Incentive & Gamified Growth Program

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "discounts, free delivery, or financing access" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "tracks participation, reward cost, and incremental purchase lift" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-477 (ensure controlled execution — MSME Growth, Credit & Digital Enablement (PA-82.3).)
- operational: lift measurement and target design
Pain Points / Risks: - **ROI risk**: Rewards without behavior change; mitigated by lift measurement and target design
System Touchpoints: - Loyalty engine (MSME segment); gamification platform; reward-redemption module

steps.activity: Loyalty designs MSME-specific incentives: purchase targets, category-expansion bonuses, referral rewards, milestone recognition
Marketing gamifies program via app (badges, leaderboards, challenges); rewards via discounts, free delivery, or financing access
Loyalty tracks participation, reward cost, and incremental purchase lift; refines program economics

workflows.name: MSME Segment P&L, Cohort Analytics & Lifetime Value

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-report of "reports segment strategy to Executive Committee" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-477 (ensure controlled execution — MSME Growth, Credit & Digital Enablement (PA-82.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Profitability risk**: Segment growth without unit economics; mitigated by cohort-level P&L discipline
System Touchpoints: - Segment P&L module; cohort analytics; LTV model

steps.activity: Finance Analyst computes MSME segment P&L: revenue, gross margin, fulfillment cost, credit loss, program cost, acquisition cost
Finance builds cohort analysis by acquisition channel, tenure, and tier; computes lifetime value and payback period
MSME Sales/FP&A uses insights to refine acquisition mix, tier benefits, and pricing; reports segment strategy to Executive Committee

steps.activity: MSME Sales/External Affairs identifies ecosystem partners: DTI Negosyo Centers, GoNegosyo, cooperatives, LGU livelihood programs
Legal structures MOU/partnership defining roles, data sharing, and revenue arrangements; ensures regulatory alignment (BOT/PPP if government)
